name: 蔡銘修
objective: This course helps the learners recognize the syntax, style, and organization as far as the papers on English writings are concerned.
schedule:
01 02/19 Intro(research topic)
02 02/26 Endnote and Turnitin (bring your own laptop)
03 03/05 AI tools for Academic writing I(bring your own laptop)
04 03/12 AI tools for Academic writing II(bring your own laptop)
05 03/19 Research- Abstract(Online synchronized class, google meet: https://meet.google.com/hjf-umdt-bkj)
06 03/26 TVET Conference
07 04/02 Research- Introduction
08 04/09 Research- Literature Review & Introduction Practice
09 04/16 Midterm Week
10 04/23 Research- Method
11 04/30 Research- Result & Discussion
12 05/07 Research- Conclusion and Suggest
13 05/14 Research- Conclusion and Suggest
14 05/21 Final Presentation 1(3 students, 20 mins per student)
15 05/28 Final Presentation 2(3 students, 20 mins per student)
16 06/04 Final Presentation 3(3 students, 20 mins per student)
17 06/11 Final Presentation 4(2 students, 20 mins per student)
18 06/18 Final Exam Week (final paper due)
scorePolicy:
Grading:
1. Attendance 15%
2. Abstract 20%  
3. Final Presentation 25%
4. Final Research Paper 40% 
    - 12 font, 1.5 spaces
    - suggest full paper (7 pages)
5. Additional grade 5% (papers are accepted in International journal or conference)
materials:
Academic Writing for Graduate Students 3/e
Author: John M. Swales, & Christine B. Feak
Publisher: Michigan Press
Publication date: 2013/3
ISBN: 9780472034758
https://www.crane.com.tw/crane/index.php?action=product_detail&prod_no=P0116400141359
可至文鶴書局購買
課程是否導入AI: ● 使用生成式 AI 作為教學過程的輔助工具（Use generative AI tools as an aid to the teaching process）● 鼓勵學生使用生成式 AI 工具（Encourage students to use generative AI tools）● 使用生成式 AI 進行課堂即時互動（Use generative AI for real-time classroom interaction）● 簡單介紹 AI 的基本概念（Briefly introduce the basic concept of AI）
remarks: SDG4：確保全面、公平及高品質教育，提倡終身學習
